henry.title: The Tokaido: Japan's Great Old Road
henry.intro: Travel back 200 years in Japan. (About 15 minutes.)
steps: 📖 Read each chunk below. Tap 🔊 if you want.
🖼️ Scroll the old prints. Find walkers and boats.
links: Scroll down. Look for people walking, horses, boats, rain and Mount Fuji.

passage.text: 🛤️ Long ago, Japan had a famous road called the Tokaido. It joined Edo (now Tokyo) and Kyoto.
passage.q: Which two cities did it join?

passage.text: 🏮 Along the road were 53 stations. These were towns with inns, food and fresh horses.
passage.q: What could travelers find at a station?

passage.text: 🚶 Most people walked. The trip was about 500 km. It took about 2 weeks.
passage.q: How long did the walk take?

passage.text: 🎨 In the 1830s, an artist named Hiroshige made a picture of every station. He carved each picture in wood, inked it and pressed paper on it. That is a woodblock print.
passage.q: How did Hiroshige make his pictures?
passage.a: Woodblock prints: carve wood, ink it, press paper.

passage.text: 🚄 Today a bullet train goes from Tokyo to Kyoto in about 2 hours.
passage.q: Which is faster, walking or the train?
passage.a: The train: 2 hours instead of 2 weeks.

words: a stop on a road, with inns and food
a picture pressed from carved wood
worksheet: The Tokaido joined Edo and ______. Circle: Kyoto / London
Edo is now called ______. Circle: Tokyo / Osaka
There were ____ stations on the road. Circle: 5 / 53 / 500
Hiroshige made ______ prints. Circle: woodblock / photo
In the prints I saw (circle all you found): people walking · cars · boats · Mount Fuji · airplanes
Walking took 2 ______. The train takes 2 ______. Circle: weeks / hours
Challenge: A traveler walks 35 km a day. How many days for 490 km? ____ days
henry.challenge: A traveler walks 35 km a day. How many days to walk 490 km? (Hint: 35 × 10 = 350. Keep adding 35.) Then find the print 'Tora's Rain at Oiso'. What is the weather?

frankie.title: Long Ago in Japan: Walk or Train? 🚶🚄
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: Long ago in Japan, people walked a long road for 2 weeks. Now a fast train does it in 2 hours! (About 14 minutes.)
steps: 👀 Look at the old pictures. Find people walking.
🚶 Walk 10 big steps like a traveler. Count!
🔤 Sound out hat, map, run. Match to pictures.
✏️ Trace, then write: I see a map. (stretch!)
links: Old pictures of the long road
Grown-up: scroll with Frankie. Point to people walking and boats.
